text:
[BEDWARS]
[+] ESP is one module per thing it draws again: Bed, Beehive, Collectable, Crate, Crop, Generator, Inventory, Item, Loot, Ore, Pot, Storage and Trap
[+] Added TimeChanger, which sets the time of day the world renders at
[+] The Kits category is now one module per kit under the game's own name, with each behaviour sitting as a toggle inside its kit (Evelynn holds AutoEvelynn, Terra holds AutoBlockKicker, and so on), plus new Builder fortify, Gompy vacuum, Marcel layout, Styx portal and Crypt gravestone behaviours
[^] AimAssist, BowAssist, TriggerBot, ProjectileAura, NameTags, SkinChanger, AutoShoot, AutoFish and AutoHotbar are the rebuilt versions, and BowAssist now aims in third person too
[^] AutoClicker gains an Attack toggle: the CPS slider only shows while it is on, and nothing swings while it is off
[^] HitregAdjuster's slider is a two-ended range, so the hitreg sits anywhere between the two numbers
[^] AutoBuildUp places continuously while space is held instead of once per jump
[^] AutoBank treats 'wool' as every wool colour, banks its Before death and While falling lists on top of the normal whitelist, hands the before-death items back once you recover, and the resource GUI is no longer clickable
[^] FastDrop's Every item drops every droppable stack, Parkour gains Auto jump, Speed's AutoJump is now the single Always jump toggle, AutoBalloon pops its balloons when it finds land below, AutoEnchant's Legit mode holds the table's own prompt, and AutoBuy's tier check always applies
[^] HitboxESP puts its Target settings at the top, and every Target Mode dropdown offers the same seven modes: Mouse, Distance, Damage, Angle, Health, Kit and Threat
[^] FPS, Ping, Memory and Speedmeter read the real thing instead of a mistimed or smoothed value
[!] Fixed SilentAim not redirecting projectiles, ProjectileAimbot never snapping to an entity, FastClimb doing nothing in BedWars, InfiniteFly lagging back over the void, Sprint dropping on respawn, PlayerOutline ignoring its colour and Chams, ProjectileLanding's aim-time prediction, ProjectileTracers' late line and MP3Player showing a song it never played
[!] Fixed Scaffold placing diagonally with Diagonal off, BlockIn reaching for blocks that are not in the hotbar, PearlTP throwing through obstacles, NoCameraCollision's snappy zoom, PearlTP's silent failures, CheatDetector writing to an 'aether' folder and AutoUpgrade announcing maxed upgrades
[!] Fixed the Legit lag in Interface and FPSBoost, and NoClip and Spider no longer describe themselves as Phase
[-] Removed Jesus, MultiAction, ArmorHighlight, LegacyAnimation, PlayerModel, Search, Theme, Waypoints, BackTrack, ClaimRewards, CustomCursor, LeaveParty, KillfeedSpoofer and AutoKit

[GENERAL]
[^] Version 3.14
